messages.body_plain:
Dear Potential Participants of WCSAM

The abstract submission and registration for the World Conference of 
Stock Assessments for Sustainable Fisheries is now open.

Please find the links on the web site: 
http://ices.dk/iceswork/symposia/wcsam.asp

More information on the theme sessions will be posted over the next few 
weeks.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards

Mark Dickey-Collas


-- 
Ernesto Jardim<ernesto.jardim at jrc.ec.europa.eu>
